arguments.query: SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT payment_status, count(*), count(distinct order_id) FROM payments GROUP BY payment_status
SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(s.order_id IS NOT NULL), sum(s.shipped_ts IS NOT NULL) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, count(distinct o.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id AND payment_status="ok") AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id AND s.shipped_ts IS NOT NULL)
